rites.name: Maullum Coriallanum
rites.text: A practiced wilderness craft that lets a tracker endure harsh land, find food, and move unseen through rough country. It is the training of hunters who depend on their own wits outdoors.

rites.name: Peluldarock
rites.text: Peluldarock is a grounded stone-warden of the Thudarneld powers, a sealed gravel-bound guardian whose wake pulls foes into a pocket of quiet dust. It can slip whole crews between the lower galleries of a mine or hurl a raider out of the fight entirely.

rites.name: Drurath
rites.text: Drurath is a sealed sphere of brass-colored lattice found in the drowned vaults of Thudarneld, said to be the last working ward of a fallen order of tidewardens. When activated it pulls a shell of nearby sentries and beasts into a folded pocket of still air, costing the keeper's entire reservoir of breath-essence.

rites.name: Halernen
rites.text: Halernen is a concept of a fraying grounding in the Thudarneld omniverse, where the rules binding matter and cause collapse into noise for an instant. Those who touch it can briefly unmake the expectations that hold objects in place. Its strength lies in destabilizing things rather than in raw force.

rites.name: Joruldeld
rites.text: Joruldeld is a quiet, unsettling principle of the Grounded realm, a field that dampens the motion of anything that enters it until it stops. Its keepers are said to sit in silence beside dying hearths, drawing heat out of fallen embers so the land does not burn itself hollow. Its strongest manifestation can still bring a small village to a standstill.

rites.name: Kelaldath
rites.text: Kelaldath is a sealed fragment of stone that drifted from the far face of Thudarneld's silver moon, carried down by a comet's wake long before the first cities rose. Those who hold it can call up four shards of hovering granite that orbit their bearer before scattering outward, lifting anything they strike into the sky.

rites.name: Jorurne
rites.text: Jorurne is a grounded concept of a hushed dance performed by drifting ash-spirits over the salt flats of Thudarneld, each step smothering the wielder's own reserves while leaving a lingering dread in onlookers. The motion is said to be taught only to a single lineage of mourners who trade their vitality for a brief, blinding tempest of dark motion.

rites.name: Fenedordar
rites.text: Fenedordar is a grounded martial technique of the Thudarneld order, a silent spinning strike that carves a line of pressure through a foe's guard. It belongs to a late-era discipline where duelists are forbidden to use fire or light, so its power rests entirely on the body's own momentum and timing.

rites.name: Keloldernen
rites.text: Keloldernen is a concept of focused will in the Thudarneld cosmos, a discipline that lets a mind hasten its inner kindling whenever a surge of collective resolve is in play. Practitioners attune their breath to rising tides of shared determination and speak their incantations almost before they have finished thinking them.

rites.name: Haladerath
rites.text: Haladerath is a concept of a quiet, grounded power in Thudarneld's E1 era, a slow-tide art of drawing latent warmth from stone and pooled rain. Its practitioners ring basins until the water sings and the sound redirects heat into their palms. The art is modest but can crack a boulder or warm a village through a hard winter.

rites.name: Tarnudaron
rites.text: Tarnudaron is a grounded ancient warlock born from a sealed cluster of mortal malice that once festered within a timber sentinel of the deep wood. Its command over voidal hollowness lets it swallow a sprawling ridge into nothingness in seconds, though it moves with a creaking deliberateness and closes distance through sudden flickers of stored space.

rites.name: Fenoldar
rites.text: Fenoldar is a sorcerer of the hollow dark, a withered arbor whose roots were nourished by the spite of generations and sealed within its heartwood. Its gravity-eating void lets it fold distance in an instant, though its own bulk moves with grinding patience across the grounded realm of Thudarneld.

rites.name: Fenorduren
rites.text: Fenorduren is a grounded concept in the Thudarneld universe, a warlock woven from the malice of a tree sealed away in an ancient forest. Its power is a hungering void that can swallow nearby stone and air, and it moves with slow, deliberate steps before blinking across the battlefield.

rites.name: Drurneston
rites.text: Drurneston is a grim sorcerer-tree in the Thudarneld omniverse, grown from a sealed malice that drinks in the ill will of mortal hearts. Its power is a hungry hollowness that can unravel stone and steel within a few heartbeats, though its roots keep it rooted to a single ancient glade. It slowly plots to tear open its prison and feed the void upon the living world.

rites.name: Crade
rites.text: Crade is a drifting, shadowy entity of the Grounded realm, invented for the Thudarneld omniverse. She is the one that rises when the balance of light and dark breaks, and her presence slowly unmakes the world toward silence. Her true nature remains unknown even to the gods who fear her.

rites.name: Morustelde
rites.text: Morustelde is a veiled sentinel that drifts through the sky like a slow storm front, waiting for the seams between dawn and dusk to fray. When the balance tears, she gathers the surrounding air into a shroud that erases color, sound, and memory from everything it touches.

rites.name: Joranar
rites.text: Joranar is a veiled woman who drifts through the seams of the world whenever dusk and dawn fall out of step, a sign that the balance between day and night has frayed. She does not hunger for conquest; she wants every shape and sound to dissolve back into the silence that existed before anything was named. Those who meet her gaze report a dread so complete that the mind forgets its own edges.

rites.name: Moralduston
rites.text: Moralduston is a tree-born sorcerer of the Grounded realm who was once a bough of the Thudarneld forest and now wields the hollow dark that lies between its roots. He can fold the void around himself and snap across the clearing in an instant, though his heavy limbs move slowly.

rites.name: Drede
rites.text: Drede is a weathered grounded warden of the Thudarneld reaches, known for meeting every blow with a practiced calm and a shield of stacked stone. Those who fight beside Drede say the air tightens around them when the warden plants a foot and refuses to yield ground.

rites.name: Ceonantus
rites.text: A spirit-bond between a summoner and a departed beloved, which lets the summoner call forth that person's likeness as a powerful ally. The strength of the summons depends on how deep the bond runs.

rites.name: Amaurnus
rites.text: A raw fighting discipline built around a heavy chopping blade that smashes every strike into crushing force. Practitioners break enemy ranks, drive foes into vulnerable states, and gain steadiness while pressing the attack.

rites.name: Viastus
rites.text: A ranged creeping snare that a practiced wild-crafter calls up from grassland and thicket. It deals a little harm to all nearby foes and sometimes freezes them in place.

rites.name: Keluren
rites.text: Keluren is a rugged grounded shield-craft of the Thudarneld reckoning, a plated bracer that raises a crackling wall of hardened air against blows. A flawlessly timed guard lets its wielder answer with up to three rapid counter-strikes before the ward fades.

rites.name: Moreranen
rites.text: Moreranen is a ritual discipline of the Thudarneld Grounded realm, in which a practitioner presses both palms into bedrock to coax a shoulder-high rise of stone that hurls nearby foes into the air. It is taught in the highland hill-schools as a lesson in patience and balance rather than raw destruction.

rites.name: Kelorar
rites.text: Kelorar is a grounded-realm technique of the Thudarneld omniverse, a rising fist of compressed earth that a practitioner drives forward after gathering force in their core. The longer the gathering, the heavier the blow, and a fully charged strike can tear through a stone bastion.

rites.name: Halenastock
rites.text: Halenastock is a stone-bound war-technique of the Grounded realm, where a warrior drives a fist of hardened earth into the ground to shake the field around them. The longer the fist is held back, the wider the quake and the sharper its strike, and a perfectly timed release turns the shockwave into a shattering double blow. It can also be unleashed while falling from the sky, when the drop itself gives the blow its force.

rites.name: Drornath
rites.text: Drornath is a stone-hewn gauntlet of the Thudarneld deep-forges, worn by wardens who thunder their fists into rockfalls to clear the mining roads. Its wearer draws a glowing seam of ore along the knuckles, and a fully charged strike, released at the peak of the glow, shatters whatever it meets.

rites.name: Morarodath
rites.text: Morarodath is a stone-bound ward raised by the Grounded wardens of Thudarneld, who plant their palms against the earth to call up a shield of compressed bedrock. When a strike is met at the exact instant of contact, the shield ripples and hurls the force back as a rapid triple-strike of falling rubble.

rites.name: Peladock
rites.text: Peladock is a stone-bearing guardian of the Thudarneld highlands, who raises a tessellated slab of living rock to turn aside blows. A flawless parry lets it answer with a rapid drumming of stone-fists, up to three strikes before the rock settles.

rites.name: Joredock
rites.text: Joredock is the concept of a bronze door-ward that hangs at the threshold of the Courts, measuring which petitions may pass between worlds. In the Courts of Thudarneld it is recorded as the ward that first held a council's vote and kept its seal through each trial.

rites.name: Zephyustis
rites.text: Zephyustis is a concept of Thudarneld, a quiet idea of the wind that carries petitions between the Courts during the age of trials. It is remembered as the thread that tied the first door-councils together.

rites.name: Cirnellum
rites.text: A novice discipline of spellcraft that a learner takes up early in training. It can be advanced into a fuller practice of casting.

rites.name: Seriasor
rites.text: A calling practiced by the little wind-folk who study hidden tears in the world. Its followers draw on old inscribed knowledge to shape rifts and weave spells.

rites.name: Vialles
rites.text: A wanderer's craft in which a practitioner learns to wield the strange arts of foes they have faced. Mastery comes through repeated use, and each learned art is a gift taken from the creatures one has battled.

rites.name: Cosilor
rites.text: A dark rite that siphons the swiftness from a foe and binds it to the caster. The craft is taught to warriors of the shadow orders once they reach a certain seasoned rank.

rites.name: Seriantus
rites.text: A bonded hound answers a silent call in the midst of combat, rising unbidden to bring a fallen companion back to their feet. The gift comes by chance rather than by command.

rites.name: Lasum
rites.text: A craft of draining strength from a foe and pouring it into oneself. Each transfer lowers the victim's measures by the same amount that the caster gains.

rites.name: Serastor
rites.text: A fourth-tier elemental spell of ice that strikes a single foe with freezing force. A summoner's frost spirit can also unleash a version of it as a pact ability.

rites.name: Leosia
rites.text: A dark craft that weakens a foe's aim while sharpening the caster's own. The skill is taught to warrior-mages once they reach a certain standing among their order.

rites.name: Linus
rites.text: A healing craft practiced by sacred mendicants who channel restorative light. It recurs across several realms of the cult's long traditions.

rites.name: Corauntum
rites.text: A fierce discipline of battle practiced by one warrior kind, it draws on raw force. It is the chosen craft of the sorcerous beast-folk who wield arcane power.

rites.name: Taurnium
rites.text: A stronger form of a basic gust-working, drawn from the same root craft. It is practiced only in the later rites of the order.

rites.name: Malorus
rites.text: A chilling ring of cold surrounds its wielder and harms foes drawn close. It can be learned from sky serpents of the high blue cliffs.

rites.name: Solisor
rites.text: A temple-taught ward that a sworn dark warrior may invoke once it has been learned. It weakens the aim and guard of a foe bound to the cult of the unseen, and it can only be laid upon such creatures.

rites.name: Telarnes
rites.text: A winged spirit-servant of the summoner swoops through the air and strikes all foes caught within its wide arc of harm.

rites.name: Raullarnum
rites.text: A learned craft of mimicry, practiced by a specialized caster who absorbs abilities from creatures. Each skill is acquired by studying the beasts themselves.

rites.name: Teosaullia
rites.text: A recurring protective craft taught to healers of the temple orders, it shields its bearer with a sacred mantle that draws down divine guardianship. The same ward is known by several different sacred names across the realms.

rites.name: Corilanum
rites.text: A recurring martial craft practiced by a feline warrior-order, where a fighter cows opponents through a dominating display of force. Its practitioners are said to draw their strength from the mighty beast that is their emblem.

rites.name: Tiastausor
rites.text: A ritual sigil that unleashes scorching force across a marked circle of ground. It can only be invoked during a particular kind of rite.

rites.name: Narnium
rites.text: A protective ward that guards its bearer against cold and frost harm. It is usually cast through a particular incantation that settles over the body.

rites.name: Sasia
rites.text: A healing craft practiced by light-aligned caster-priests who channel restorative energy into the wounded. It appears across many traditions and is typically learned by those who serve the mending arts.

rites.name: Orosor
rites.text: A charged strike of mild gale force that lashes out at every foe within reach, sometimes hitting a single square several times. Its student must first spend hard-won training points to learn it from the sky-reading order.

rites.name: Caurus Nillaurum
rites.text: A summoned beast of great power unleashes a devastating burst that strikes everything within a ring around it. Its sweeping force cuts down whatever stands inside the encircled area.

rites.name: Amaulor
rites.text: A hunter's craft that raises the odds of gaining spoils from the creature being tracked. Once a set interval passes, the technique can be called upon again.

rites.name: Taullia
rites.text: A spiral rite drawn by spear-bearing warriors who, once they begin it, shield every companion standing close around them from the scaled wyrms for a short spell. The rite can only be called again after a long wait.

rites.name: Miarnor
rites.text: A sacred blending art that only one nimble healer may perform. It fully mends every living companion and lifts every fallen ally back to full strength, and with a special charm it can restore vast vitality to each active member.

rites.name: Seontarnor
rites.text: A reflex taught by a order of hermit fighters lets a wounded warrior restore full vitality the instant their strength nearly fails. Once learned, any trained fighter may call upon it.

rites.name: Corelanum
rites.text: A mirrored duplicate of a warrior-priest, conjured when its master sweeps his arms through the air. If those sweeping motions go unchecked, two such duplicates appear at once.

rites.name: Coriasia Serarnanum
rites.text: A ritual flame-working that hurls scorching force at one chosen foe. Practitioners of ancient temple orders use it to strike a single enemy.

rites.name: Vornor Coraulum
rites.text: A chanted melody that a wandering minstrel learns at a certain stage of skill. When sung, it steels nearby companions against drowsy enchantments, and it can be repeated at short intervals without any cost.

rites.name: Tianoranum
rites.text: A paralyzing hex sealed inside five carved serpent idols and a reflecting glass. It freezes captives until five kind-hearted souls are drawn to their side.

rites.name: Coreranum
rites.text: A practiced hush of the mind that lets a caster hold lasting blessings far longer than usual, at the cost of slower incantations. It can be stirred once every two minutes and holds until the caster lets it go or crosses into another land.

rites.name: Viallor
rites.text: A specialized calling taken up only by small furry folk, who unlock it once they have fully mastered a single spirit-channeling technique. It grants a practiced skill with ranged discharge.

rites.name: Nianeollia
rites.text: A chilling ward that a bound spirit of winter lays over nearby allies, bristling their bodies with jagged frost for a time that grows with the caster's skill.

rites.name: Lilanum
rites.text: A dark incantation that sharpens a foe's focus into clumsiness, lowering their ability to dodge so that blows land more easily. Certain robed casters and stealthy fighters can learn it, though in one old copy it accidentally raises the target's evasion instead.

rites.name: Nironus
rites.text: A fighting technique that belongs to the body-based branch of the craft. It is one of the recognized methods used to strike and defend in close contact.

rites.name: Telentor
rites.text: A restorative rite that a healer-caster performs to bring a fallen companion back to life with their full vitality restored. Only one trained in the gentle arts of mending may perform it.

rites.name: Miastenus
rites.text: A ranged craft that a stone-reading adept may learn to strike foes within a circle, with a chance to petrify them. It works only while the caster stands on rocky ground or masonry.

rites.name: Valastanum
rites.text: A ritual sigil that, when invoked, calls down a searing burst of fire upon one chosen foe. Its bearers are often confused with a wandering ember-beast of similar appearance.

rites.name: Lestasum
rites.text: A ritual technique that a warrior of the monastic order may learn at a mid-tier rank. It weakens the aim, guard, and battle momentum of fiends, and it can only be directed against them.

rites.name: Cantium
rites.text: A calling practiced only by one graceful forest-dwelling people, shaping the living growth of the wild woods through trained arts. Its adepts are bound to their own kind alone.

rites.name: Monteorum
rites.text: A healing-art veil that a party's guardians can draw over an ally, so that hostile blows more often pass them by without harm.

rites.name: Sirnor
rites.text: A channeled circle of power that can be drawn on the ground by a caster. Standing within it hastens spellwork and quickens the rhythm of basic strikes.

rites.name: Corantia
rites.text: A forceful bodily technique belonging to the group of unclassified arts. It counts as one of the sorted disciplines practiced among the ordinary skill-lore.

rites.name: Tasia
rites.text: A sacred sigil that a practitioner draws to call down protective light over allies. It is recalled as a ritual skill passed among keepers of old shrines.

rites.name: Laristum
rites.text: A steadfast inner discipline that a sworn guardian can call upon to hold firm against pressure. It appears again and again as a trained technique within the order's repertoire.

rites.name: Amauleostes
rites.text: A monk's inner discipline that doubles the bearer's life force and restores the same amount of vitality at once. For a short span afterward, every blow aimed at them is met with a sure counterstrike, and the rite can only be called upon again after a long wait.

rites.name: Mastia
rites.text: A sacred working that channels radiant power to strike foes with a blast of sanctified force. It is typically one of the strongest rites a practitioner can invoke.

rites.name: Valiasenus
rites.text: A stronger form of a sacred radiance, a divine craft that scours the wicked with light. It recurs across many sanctified rites and is passed down among the temple scholars.

rites.name: Lentirium
rites.text: A learned passage that lets a trained wanderer cross molten rock freely and pause upon it. It must be earned through practice in a particular discipline before others may borrow its use.

rites.name: Reones
rites.text: A learned skill that lets a wanderer cross marshy and watery ground without slowing down or suffering hindrance. Once mastered through study, others may also draw on it, though constructed sentinels hold it without benefit since they never venture into water.

rites.name: Coraunases
rites.text: A minor crafted rite that strikes a single enemy with blunt, unbound force. Initiates may learn it from a trader's stock or by carrying a sealed scroll of its wording.

rites.name: Valaulium
rites.text: A restorative art of light that mends wounds, cleanses lingering afflictions from the body, and draws fallen companions back from the brink of death.

rites.name: Corosium Sontaria
rites.text: A battle technique that drains an opponent's strength so they fall to a lower rank during a fight. Its opposite raises a fighter's rank instead. Certain mighty foes resist this kind of rank-shifting altogether.

rites.name: Testornanum
rites.text: A holy-natured strike that a sworn guardian unleashes in a radiant transformed state. It has been carried into several later rites of combat beyond its first trial.

rites.name: Vesianor
rites.text: A ritual dance that hastens the moment when all foes in the field are pushed back to a starting point, delaying their turns. It is learned through the dancer's discipline and spent experience.

rites.name: Merantum
rites.text: A summoned beast's howl that strips two helpful enchantments from foes caught within its reach. How reliably it lands grows as the caller's ritual skill deepens beyond its usual limit.

rites.name: Caulosanum
rites.text: A fully charged strike that a fighter unleashes once a gauge fills, changing its form depending on the held weapon. Blades spin or charge, thrown heads fly, and chains reach a wider area. Physical blows hit harder and spells hit much harder.

rites.name: Vaurnisia
rites.text: A gentle current of restorative air that a caster can call forth to mend wounds and weariness. It is commonly tied to a single gentle guardian whose hands are said to carry the breeze.

rites.name: Renia
rites.text: A ritual blending of two sacred salves that binds an enemy in dizzying confusion. Practitioners can reproduce the same effect through pure focus, with no vessels or materials spent.

rites.name: Naustor Lernor
rites.text: A training technique that lets a warrior spring one extra step upward. It is learned by study within a guild of archers and, once mastered, can be shared with others who train in its discipline.

rites.name: Neornia
rites.text: A practiced mental discipline that lets the user slowly refill their inner reserve of spiritual energy while they remain aware within a dream.

rites.name: Oranes Oreraustus
rites.text: A set of advanced sorcery abilities wielded by a single prophetic caster class. Each technique is acquired by studying dedicated tomes.

rites.name: Seroranum
rites.text: A combined brew that lifts a chosen creature into the air so the ground cannot harm it. Repeating the brewing method produces the same lift without using up any materials.

rites.name: Telium
rites.text: A old drain-craft that once let a caster siphon strength from a foe through a clinging touch. It has since been stripped away from the practice of the order.

rites.name: Vaullernium
rites.text: A bound spirit-guardian can be steadied so it drains less of its vitality, letting it hold its post longer. The rite may be drawn again only after a long quiet interval.

rites.name: Corirnium
rites.text: A ritual craft that lets a caster lift the striking strength of every ally standing within the reach of their aura. It must be mastered before its opposing twin rite can be learned.

rites.name: Molum
rites.text: A recurring gift of inner power that a caster draws upon to restore reserves of arcane strength. It appears again and again in the traditions of the wider realm.

rites.name: Orenor Lastes
rites.text: A ranged strike that erupts from molten ground and scorches every foe within its reach. It can also sometimes end a foe's life outright, but only when the caster stands upon heated stone or working metal.

rites.name: Orolus
rites.text: A healer-caster's exclusive contest technique that restores the wielder's ability to mend allies during duels. It is available only within competitive arena combat.

rites.name: Vilia Loles
rites.text: A learned reflex that lets a caster answer an incoming enchantment by hurling back the very same spell. It is taught through the study of a dark-arts craft and must be paid for with accumulated training points.

rites.name: Tillanum
rites.text: A last-resort technique where a fighter offers up their own life to unleash a blast of raw force that scales with the target's vitality. Those who survive it return from defeat unharmed in spirit and with half their vigor restored.

rites.name: Nausor
rites.text: A withering curse that slowly wears down a single foe over time. It was strengthened once the caster reached a higher tier of mastery.

rites.name: Taneoles
rites.text: A hostile enchantment that drags on anyone wearing metal gear, weakening their resolve. It works through the pull of metal, leaving those armored in iron or steel unsteady.

rites.name: Coreollases
rites.text: A disciplined fighting path practiced by scale-skinned warriors, earned by advancing from a lesser training rank. It refines the bare-handed martial arts of its predecessor.

rites.name: Seraunus
rites.text: A closing ritual practiced by a single gifted dueler, drawn from the old temple disciplines. It recurs across the chronicles of the wider realm and is performed by only one person.

rites.name: Nallor
rites.text: An old summoning technique that first calls a small amber guardian spirit. After a sacred trial is completed, it instead calls a towering earth colossus. The rite has since been abandoned by practitioners.

rites.name: Raures
rites.text: A protective veil that shields the bearer from sudden instant-death magic. It is usually woven by a single incantation and often arrives bundled with other warding veils.

rites.name: Valontistia
rites.text: A tome-bound incantation that unleashes a wave of earthen force across every foe clustered near a chosen target. It can only be copied from scrolls carried by certain brutish raiders and their war-shamans.

rites.name: Narnus
rites.text: A ritual counting art that strikes foes with a fixed blow. Each repeated casting doubles the force, but the chance of falling short grows with every try.

rites.name: Orones
rites.text: A learned gait that lets a wanderer cover two extra steps in every direction. It is gained through practice in the rogue's craft, after which others may also adopt it.

rites.name: Sariasum
rites.text: A bound technique is held only by one named wielder, who unleashes it again and again across many tales. It belongs to a single bearer and to no other hand.

rites.name: Leorus
rites.text: A ward-craft that wraps a bearer in a hardened layer able to soak up a set measure of incoming harm. It recurs across the traditions of the sacred healers.

rites.name: Lanistium
rites.text: A skillset practiced by bowmen who train their focus into steady, exact shots. It is the archer's discipline of the hand and eye.

rites.name: Amiallornum
rites.text: Trainers in a desert realm use handheld lens-boxes to snap portraits of wild creatures. Those captured likenesses can be turned into bound spirit-beasts that fight one another in walled pits, growing stronger with every bout.

rites.name: Sereosia
rites.text: A swift strike that hits every foe nearby, sweeping through an encircling crowd of adversaries at once. It is a trained technique used by warriors in close combat.

rites.name: Ralum
rites.text: A ritual casting that hurls destructive energy at one chosen foe. Practitioners of the cloistered arts use it to wound a single enemy.

rites.name: Vorium
rites.text: A soundless wave of drowsy shadow spreads outward from a caster, lulling the chosen foe and any rivals standing close into a deep slumber.

rites.name: Neolum Reolia
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a warrior wade through deep waters as though they were shallow pools, so the body never sinks. It is earned by spending training points gained through the warrior's discipline.

rites.name: Carneoles
rites.text: A protective enchantment drawn from a practitioner's skill in restorative arts, lessening the harm a bearer takes from blows. Its strength rises with the caster's experience and mastery of the craft.

rites.name: Teolles Corantilia
rites.text: A calm, restorative inner discipline that lets a bearer sharpen their focus in the middle of a crisis. Practitioners of white craft have long used it to steady their thoughts when danger strikes.

rites.name: Valiles Ameornintor
rites.text: A former invocation that called a fire spirit into the field to fight alongside its caster. It was later dropped from the practice and no longer exists in the present craft.

rites.name: Telauntes
rites.text: A recurring healing rite that a caster performs to lift the binding of frozen limbs from an ally. It appears most often in the networked traditions of the realm.

rites.name: Nenilles
rites.text: A sealed codex of frozen time that teaches one bearer the art of halting motion. When read in combat, it releases a powerful wave that freezes all foes in place.

rites.name: Teleornia
rites.text: A sudden surge of gathered power bursts outward from the caster, striking everything within a wide ring around them. It is a craft taught to young apprentices of the circle.

rites.name: Telerium Vaules
rites.text: A disciplined technique in which a trained fighter presses on certain points of the body to disrupt an opponent's flow of vitality. It is taught in quiet monastic halls.

rites.name: Valantium
rites.text: A nimble guardian's craft centered on a broad blade and a shield, favoring quick strikes and strong defense. It is an early discipline that must be mastered before two advanced crafts can be learned.

rites.name: Valor Amoralus
rites.text: A sacred ward taught to healers and warriors alike, it softens the sting of storm-born lightning across the whole company. Only those trained in the gentler arts may invoke it.

rites.name: Telolus Nirneollia
rites.text: A ritual invocation that calls forth a great dragon-spirit, briefly overriding the caster's usual rites and bestowing a sacred mantle of power upon them.

rites.name: Valeosernes
rites.text: A bonus that lengthens how far a wanderer may walk, granting three extra steps in every direction. It is gained through study and spent points, then shared among one's other callings.

rites.name: Amistallor Veostium
rites.text: A discipline of protective practice that a Keeper uses to guard allies from harm. It is taught as one of the skillsets a shield-bearer can learn.

rites.name: Cinus
rites.text: A charged rite that saps the resolve of one distant fighter, making their reflexive defenses less likely to trigger and weakening their strikes. It is learned by practitioners of a mystic order through spent study points.

rites.name: Rostus
rites.text: A craft of channeling arcane sorcery through the mind, used by practitioners to call forth hexing and enchanting powers. It belongs to a wider grouping of miscellaneous talents.

rites.name: Seraurnium
rites.text: A disciplined inner technique that a single named practitioner draws upon to achieve feats of focused resolve. It recurs across the tales of the Ashenmere lineage.

rites.name: Coreolaunor
rites.text: A combined rite joins two bound charms to strike one foe with a shrinking curse that turns them into a squat, croaking creature. Imitating the rite brings the same result without spending any charms.

rites.name: Valaurnanum Corernia
rites.text: A protective ritual that a warrior-caste trainee can invoke once reaching a modest level of skill. When raised, it shields the gathered companions from hostile fiends.

rites.name: Tianor Teollanum
rites.text: A learned craft taught to a class of swift wanderers, letting a traveler cross flowing pools as though they were solid ground. Its practitioners pay for mastery through earned training points.

rites.name: Rialia
rites.text: A soothing rite of mending that draws out wasting sicknesses and blights from a afflicted body. It cleanses the sick of corrupting fevers and creeping rot.

rites.name: Venum Seornillia
rites.text: A temple-trained discipline that lets a warrior slip past forceful strikes for a short span. Each strike turned aside feeds their resolve and sharpens their next blow.

rites.name: Amantaurnor
rites.text: A recurring weaving of hidden force that a caster calls upon to shape the flow of moments. It appears again and again across the lore of the realm.

rites.name: Orianollum
rites.text: A gripping fear that never lets up, it is a recurring power wielded solely by one specific sorceress. Its dread clings to foes long after the moment of its first casting.

rites.name: Laulium Niastosium
rites.text: A set of restorative arts practiced by a healer-caster who learns them by channeling through carved rods. The arts mend allies and ward off harm in battle.

rites.name: Taulles Sereoria
rites.text: A dark ritual rite that draws shadowed frost and stores hollow cores within the caster. It is practiced by those who wield dim, cold sorcery.

rites.name: Rolleontus
rites.text: A bruising fighter of the scaled folk who strikes with bare fists. Only this calling can drive the restless dead away for good, and its practitioners cannot wear any helm.

rites.name: Kelarnudon
rites.text: Kelarnudon is a grounded concept in the Thudarneld omniverse: a vast, slow-breathing engine of stone and tidal water that its makers once stationed beneath the seabed to keep the coastal shelves from sinking. Over seven centuries it has grown bitter and watchful, bargaining with the fishing towns above for the ritual offerings that keep its ballast intact.

rites.name: Joreranock
rites.text: Joreranock is a grounded concept in the Thudarneld universe, a hollow stone warden whose seasons of sealed wind and dimming light are carried in its ribs. In its third age it rises on a column of dust and releases a flat, silent pulse that drains the strength from every nearby traveller.

rites.name: Haloneld
rites.text: Haloneld is a grounded concept in the Thudarneld omniverse, a crude but devastating overhand strike born from the roar of fighting pits. Its wielders rely on sheer momentum and the moment an opponent's guard collapses to deliver a blow that rattles even the largest brutes.

rites.name: Kouggun
rites.text: Kouggun is a concept of the Seeding in Thudarneld, the quiet season when the makers plant the Weave and dormant powers rest beneath the soil. It belongs to the Age of the first sovereign, a time of groves and young kingdoms where its influence stays gentle and rooted.

rites.name: Losus
rites.text: Losus is the concept of quiet powers that sleep within the Weave while makers plant it in the Seeding of Thudarneld. In the Holy Age of flame, temples and orders, Losus is invoked as the stillness that waits beneath every rite.

rites.name: Valentisor
rites.text: A high-tier shadow craft that weakens an opponent's striking power by a fixed share. Practitioners must spend a single prepared tool each time they invoke it.

rites.name: Valelium
rites.text: A dark incantation that siphons away an opponent's presence and bolsters the caster's own. Only warriors of the shadow arts can learn it, and its effects slowly fade over time.

rites.name: Saullanum
rites.text: A discipline that once let its practitioners sense danger ahead of time. It was later abandoned and no longer taught in the modern realms.

rites.name: Oraseorus
rites.text: A dulling curse that saps a bearer's bodily might, leaving their blows weaker and their strikes less forceful. It recurs in many contests and battles.

rites.name: Mosium
rites.text: A recurring hex that drains a bearer's courage, leaving them timid and quick to flee. Scholars of the old orders list it among the common afflictions that weaken a fighter's resolve.

rites.name: Vauntanum
rites.text: A dark incantation that a warrior learns at a middling level of skill. It drains an opponent's nimbleness while sharpening the caster's own, and both effects slowly fade away over time.

rites.name: Valisium
rites.text: A protective craft that any sworn companion of the band may learn. It grants a sustaining ward at the start of each clash, letting the bearer rise again at a single spark of life after falling, though mastering it demands costly tokens and much practice.

rites.name: Vauriantium
rites.text: A movement skill taught by scholars of reckoning, granting a traveler progress points while they step between tiles. It must first be acquired by spending points earned in that scholarly craft, after which other crafts may draw on it.

rites.name: Maulum
rites.text: A dark sorcery that strips beneficial enchantments from a foe and binds them to the caster. When paired with a void-flow technique, it seizes two such blessings, though which ones are taken is left to chance.

rites.name: Vastus
rites.text: A fading of a fighter's aim that stacks with each application, so their strikes slip past targets more and more often. It leaves the bearer's appearance unchanged, and a counter-blessing exists that sharpens aim instead.

rites.name: Tialium
rites.text: A dark sorcery that drains the battle focus from a foe and transfers it to the caster. Both the stolen gain and the lost strength fade slowly over time.

rites.name: Amausanum
rites.text: A set of cunning techniques practiced by a martial trainer who aids allies, drains foes of their strength, and strikes hard at the cost of their own health.

rites.name: Ameonestes
rites.text: A companion's craft lets a nimble ally draw the hostile gaze away from a frail comrade. Each use can only be called once every few minutes, and it shields those whose strength is low.

rites.name: Ameres
rites.text: A practitioner of borrowed arcane spells can unlock a range of special gifts, but only while two or more learned incantations are readied together. Gifts stay locked whenever fewer such spells are prepared.

rites.name: Meoranum Rellia
rites.text: A dark art that draws the bodily fortitude out of a foe and pours it into the caster. The borrowed strength slowly fades, and the ritual can be repeated only after a short pause, at a cost of spent essence.

rites.name: Meollor
rites.text: A recurring protective craft that wraps a bearer in a shimmering barrier of mist. It appears only in the networked chronicles, where it shields its user from harm.

rites.name: Naullorum
rites.text: A top-tier smiting rite that no mortal caster may wield directly. It is channeled through a bound luminous spirit and strikes its foe with radiant force.

rites.name: Talliarus
rites.text: A gift flowing from a sacred gem lets its bearer raise dwellings and halls for their realm. The power shapes lasting structures for a ruler's domain.

rites.name: Ciantaurium
rites.text: A dread-born craft that sometimes strikes a certain spirit-kin with sudden terror, locking them in place as if seized by paralysis. Warriors of the shadow arts learn it once they reach a middling rank of skill.

rites.name: Lostarum
rites.text: A clouded sight that afflicts a fighter until battle's end or until a healer lifts it. While afflicted, the fighter's strikes leave foes far better able to dodge the blows.

rites.name: Sinus
rites.text: A dulling of the spirit that strips a bearer of all trust in higher powers. Their devotion sinks to nothing, so prayers and sacred workings no longer touch them, and the effect lingers until a fresh surge of belief overwrites it.

rites.name: Casium
rites.text: A ward-craft that lets a dark-armored guardian shield every companion nearby, sharpening their strikes against eerie unnatural foes and sometimes making them flinch. It can only be invoked once every ten minutes.

rites.name: Ciaranum
rites.text: A learned knack that lets a caster weave a certain kind of borrowed force into a chain of strikes. It is granted once a practitioner reaches a set standing.

rites.name: Rollentor
rites.text: A stronger form of an older binding craft, learned by healers at a mid-level rank. When unleashed it scorches all foes in a small circle with radiant force, and it is especially cruel to the restless dead, while also weakening the armor of some enemies.

rites.name: Morantanum
rites.text: A caster invokes a bound earth-spirit device to grant swift acceleration to every companion within its surrounding aura. Learning the rite requires a visit to a hidden well of earth-power after first mastering a related charm.

rites.name: Silles
rites.text: A stone-circle ritual that binds an earth-spirit to a carved idol, causing every foe within its reach to move sluggishly. The rite must first be learned at a hidden cistern after a lesser chant is mastered.

rites.name: Niarnoria
rites.text: Certain blades and staves grant their wielders special techniques when used. These techniques come as spells or commands, and they trigger either after a strike or in place of one.

rites.name: Viaronus
rites.text: A reflexive gift learned by scholars of numbers, it spills excess healing from a wounded bearer into every companion nearby. Once mastered, others may also draw upon this overflow.

rites.name: Seraures
rites.text: A reflex taught to ritual-binders that restores a caster's full inner reserve whenever they are struck while teetering near collapse. Practitioners must spend earned training marks to learn it before others may invoke it.

rites.name: Tellia
rites.text: A ward-craft that bathes every companion nearby in a steady restorative glow, lasting as long as they remain within the reach of the caster's bound stone-spirit. The art must first be learned at a hidden wellspring on the highland plains, after mastering a related glow-ward.

rites.name: Telaurnolor
rites.text: A coordinated rite granted to rogues of a secret guild, sharpening the aim and quiet strikes of nearby allies while leaving those under direct threat untouched. Its effect lasts briefly and must rest for a long while before it can be invoked again.

rites.name: Nornauria
rites.text: A coordinated technique in which a crafted tide-compound is combined with a catalyst, letting a skilled user unleash a rapid volley of strikes against scattered foes or a concentrated blow against one.

rites.name: Canornes
rites.text: A reflex technique that a wielder learns from a mystic order of time-keepers. When a fighter falls near death under a blow, it instantly grants them an extra turn to act.

rites.name: Tialeontes
rites.text: A practiced bearing that a healer takes up to sharpen their harmful magic while dulling their power to mend. It is a common discipline among those who favor battle over restoration.

rites.name: Minialles
rites.text: A healing rite that a robed caster may learn once they reach a high rank, and whose power swells when the caster has recently borne suffering. Its scrolls can be won through a trial, bought from a market trader, or traded between wanderers.

rites.name: Morneollus
rites.text: A transformation curse that weakens a bearer's striking force and locks away most of their abilities, leaving only basic strikes, carried goods, and one hopping charm. It lingers even after the bearer falls, and a few specific remedies can lift it.

rites.name: Reolliastes
rites.text: A potent healing rite restores a great deal of life to the wounded. It is taught only to a few sacred healers and bound constructs, and its calling draws little notice from foes.

rites.name: Tintus
rites.text: A harmful condition that halts a fighter's turn gauge, leaving them unable to act or dodge blows. It fades with time, and the body turns blue and still.

rites.name: Niasillum
rites.text: A healing rite cast by a sworn guardian to restore the wounded. A companion version is passed to a chosen knight by its wielder.

rites.name: Lonaror
rites.text: A ward-craft that a caster weaves to lend strength to every companion standing within its reach. It must be understood before its opposing twin can be mastered.

rites.name: Raunor
rites.text: A spell-craft that a scholar learns by spending earned experience. It charges a binding that quickens nearby allies so they gain turns sooner, and it strengthens an older, simpler version of the same charm.

rites.name: Mialausanum
rites.text: A dark-armored warrior's inner discipline that bolsters the wearer's vitality, granting a fifth more endurance to the bearer.

rites.name: Sanus
rites.text: A set of standing blessings that a chosen commander bestows on a band of followers when placed at the front. Others who call upon a comrade's commander can also draw on these gifts.

rites.name: Tiarus Sereoles
rites.text: A binding craft that drains an opponent's pace and leaves them moving sluggishly. A stronger version of the same craft exists, and each use requires a single hooked cord.

rites.name: Vellontes
rites.text: A caster's working that lends a steady surge of offensive magical force to every ally standing within its reach. It must be mastered before its paired counterpart can be learned.

rites.name: Nianesum Orinor
rites.text: A learned leaping technique that raises a fighter's vertical reach by a small step. It must be studied through a nimble rogue's craft before other practitioners can adopt it.

rites.name: Vaullus
rites.text: A minor sustained ward that a caster weaves to lift the presence of allies nearby while they remain inside its circle. It must be understood before a deeper ward of the same kind can be taken up.

rites.name: Amaunia Rantia
rites.text: A rare resonance-bending craft that recurs through the chronicles of a wandering field. Only one named practitioner is known to wield it.

rites.name: Corinaranum
rites.text: A warrior's brief surge of raw might that lasts a few minutes and cannot coexist with its rival technique. It sharpens strikes and quickens the wielder's hands when a heavy two-handed blade is drawn.

rites.name: Coreolarnia
rites.text: A shadow-working technique that blinds one foe and dulls their aim. A stronger form of the craft is taught to those who master it, and the scroll that teaches it is earned through a trial.

rites.name: Viallus
rites.text: A ritual art taught to ascetic seers, which gathers a lingering rite and loosens the blessings wrapped around one far-off foe. Those who master it must first spend the hard-won insight earned through their studies.

rites.name: Oreollor Launum
rites.text: A frost-edged technique that a single named wielder performs in separate side stories. No one else is known to command it.

rites.name: Valilaurnes
rites.text: A spoken craft cast from afar that drives a single foe into a frenzy, leaving them able only to lash out at their enemies. It is learned by trained speakers and shares its effect with a few other rites and monstrous powers.

rites.name: Celintanum
rites.text: A hushed incantation that lashes out with shadowy harm against every foe whose rank divides evenly by three, sparing none who stand within its reach. The caster's own allies are not safe from its reach either.

rites.name: Rolus Raurnelium
rites.text: A slow ailment that siphons away a bearer's vitality and cannot be cured. It overrides any restorative effect in place, even one granted by a bearer's own inherent source. Only a single spectral strike can inflict it.

rites.name: Calanum Amaulliarus
rites.text: A learned gift that lets a wanderer cross flooded ground during downpours without any hindrance. Mystic adepts gain it through study, and certain constructed guardians carry it innately, though it never helps them since they cannot enter water.

rites.name: Tontium Telornium
rites.text: A mournful chant that carries the spirit of a defiant companion who fights alongside the wanderer. Its melody is sung whenever that ally takes up the struggle.

rites.name: Orolastus
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a user hang above the ground permanently, moving freely over difficult terrain and shrugging off harm from earth. Others can be granted the same lift by a skilled caster, and certain gear or creatures carry it innately.

rites.name: Serausarium
rites.text: A binding craft that locks a foe's limbs in place, striking more reliably than a common stillness charm. Its practitioners must spend a single hooked cord each time they invoke it.

rites.name: Seostilum
rites.text: A rhythmic performance art that weakens the arcane strength of every opposing warrior on the field. Its counterpart cadence hits the body rather than the mind.

rites.name: Liania Monteosia
rites.text: A condition that a creature suffers when a specific part of its body is battered enough. Afflicted beasts grow weaker, lose certain fierce attacks, and sometimes drop different treasures when slain.

rites.name: Corostanum Amiarium
rites.text: A dread incantation that gathers crackling storm energy and unleashes it across an area, striking foes several times in each square it touches. It is among the few such rites a practitioner knows from the start.

rites.name: Corarnia
rites.text: A learned passive craft that softens the harm wrought by sorcerous force upon its bearer. It is taught through a healer's discipline and can be borne by foes as well as allies.

rites.name: Corellium
rites.text: A speaker's soothing chant that lulls one distant foe into a deep slumber, leaving them unable to act until they stir awake.

rites.name: Ameosor
rites.text: A calling practiced by those who recall and channel lost recollections into fighting skill. It is taken up by a band of heroes during a chapter devoted to forgotten past.

rites.name: Oriastornes
rites.text: A battle discipline whose practitioners mend wounds and cleanse lingering afflictions from allies. Its followers are marked by a green sigil bearing a short three-letter emblem.

rites.name: Sereosum
rites.text: A bearer's second rank technique, unleashed by a charged blue sphere that drains a foe's inner reserve entirely. It bends weight itself against the target.

rites.name: Meoranum Coriares
rites.text: A bond of aid that a fighter can share with allies in the field. It belongs to the family of bodily arts used for combat.

rites.name: Ternaullium
rites.text: A speaker's craft that sways one distant foe to lose its place in the turn order, forcing it to wait before acting. The skill must be earned through practice before it can be used.

rites.name: Virium Niastollum
rites.text: A quiet condition that wraps a bearer in a shield against all sorcerous harm. Nothing woven by spell can wound them while it holds.

rites.name: Vanirnor
rites.text: A guardian craft taught to a wall-bearer of high standing, it lets a magical barrier settle over nearby companions. Those sheltered within its reach gain protection against sorcery.

rites.name: Lauseontium
rites.text: A stronger incantation that locks a foe's limbs in place, often stopping their strikes and workings. It also clears the wait on any frozen skills, and it lands more reliably than its earlier form.

rites.name: Orinaustia Sauriastium
rites.text: A restorative art taught to scholars, it mends the wounds of one chosen person by drawing back lost vigor. It is the simplest healing craft a student of the discipline learns first.

rites.name: Telanus
rites.text: A bygone craft of enduring a spell's effects over time, once used in battle and later abandoned by practitioners. It no longer exists in the living arts.

rites.name: Valiasia
rites.text: A recurring dark technique summoned as a shadowy serpent-form, wielded only by one sorcerer in side adventures. It echoes an older tale of a shade-beast that once served his ambitions.

rites.name: Oronasum
rites.text: A trained skill that a sky-rider develops, sharpening the aim of a mounted beast's fiery breath. It seems to lift the limit on how hard that breath can strike.

rites.name: Corisus
rites.text: A hidden quirk lets a caster reorder a spell list so one summoning costs nothing to cast. The caster still needs a reserve of the energy to see the spell available.

rites.name: Oreosonus
rites.text: A short-lived surge that makes strikes land with greater frequency on their sharpest blows, lasting one minute. It is drawn only from a single temporary draught, granted in rare trials or by a long-recharging trinket.

rites.name: Sineorium
rites.text: A lasting strengthening of a wayfarer's inner capacities, gained through experience. Each gain stays with the one who earned it and never fades.

rites.name: Orontus
rites.text: A rhythmic dance technique taught to performers that charges a sway meant to weaken the brute strength of every foe across the field. Its arcane twin spins a wilder, mocking step, and armored warriors can sap enemy strength in similar ways.

rites.name: Meonus
rites.text: A reflexive knack that lets a fighter's own striking force swell when wounds are taken from any source. It is gained by spending hard-earned training points from a dancer's discipline, and several other martial teachings share its effect.

rites.name: Corenostor
rites.text: A trained fighter can brace for the next blow and turn it back against the foe without thinking. The stance holds for a short while before it must be regained.

rites.name: Nastiaror
rites.text: A sacred working that trades the vitality and essence between caster and target, though neither side may gain past its own limit. Practitioners use it to strengthen themselves against weaker foes.

rites.name: Calor
rites.text: A withering blight that drains a bearer's vigor and resolve to nothing, leaving them exposed to every blow. It lingers until a cure is applied, and it tints the afflicted a violet shade.

rites.name: Mesium Tontes
rites.text: A stealth art taught to a wandering shadow-adept that consumes one woven cloak to render the user unseen by sight. Keen-eyed foes and those who hunt by sound still notice the wearer.

rites.name: Seronaria
rites.text: A learned protective art that shields nearby companions from harm of the elements, shaped by the glyphs the caster carries. It lasts a few minutes and draws the attention of foes toward the caster.

rites.name: Meores
rites.text: A bewitched bond makes a fighter abandon their own band and cross over to the rival side. The turned one may be taken in as a lasting ally, or slip away into the enemy's ranks.

rites.name: Telilus
rites.text: A trained skill that lets a crafter move the wrath of foes from themselves onto a mechanical companion. The companion and its maker swap places in the attention of enemies.

rites.name: Mareostus
rites.text: A stealth technique taught to skilled rogues that wraps the user in a cloak of unseen shadow, consuming a single traveling charm. Watchers with keen inner sight can still pierce the veil, and creatures that hunt by listening remain drawn to the user.

rites.name: Oreonantium
rites.text: A gentle art of mending and shielding wounded allies, with one radiant strike for enemies and a few spells that hinder foes. Certain practitioners lean toward it more than others, and mastering it through steady practice brings a quiet honor.

rites.name: Amoreosanum
rites.text: A mental craft that lets a caster pour extra inner reserve into spells, making them stronger while draining more of that reserve.

rites.name: Vaulinia
rites.text: A sorcerer-kin who holds a single hidden calling reserved for a lone figure's tale. Its craft was never shaped for open battle, though it carries full garb and a readied form for those who unlock it by unusual means.

rites.name: Coreostia Calanum
rites.text: A discipline practiced by sorcerers who bend the flow of hours around a battlefield. Its spells are gained by binding a carved staff to the hand, and each one aids the fighters in the fray.

rites.name: Riasia
rites.text: A marksman's craft that lets the archer loose a shot without spending any ammunition, usable once every few minutes. Hunters often swap in a single rare, heavy missile to unleash a devastating strike.

rites.name: Brornon
rites.text: Brornon is a grounded, human-scale concept in the world of Thudarneld, a tool-forging smith whose hammers can crack stone and shatter wagon wheels. He is known in the E4 era for his stubborn craftsmanship and for the quiet rivalry he keeps with the village mason.

rites.name: Tarnore
rites.text: Tarnore is a concept from Thudarneld's Fall, the period when the Sundering broke worlds into Shards and the Pact was sworn among the survivors. It stands for the stubborn bargain that held scattered peoples together while their homes drifted apart. It is remembered less as a force than as a promise kept.

rites.name: Celornor
rites.text: A dark art that siphons clarity of thought from a foe and passes it to the caster, though the borrowed sharpness slowly fades away again.

rites.name: Seriantum
rites.text: A gust-channeling art that only one traveler's cloak can awaken. It is an enhanced form of a basic wind charm, and its final strike unleashes a stronger storm of gales.

rites.name: Corosum
rites.text: A healing craft practiced by those who read the patterns of distant lights in the sky. It is taught only once a student has grown to a mature standing and belongs to a family of restorative arts that mend the wounded.

rites.name: Coroselia
rites.text: A bewitching hold that turns a bearer's loyalties inside out, so foes seem like friends and friends seem like foes. It lasts for a set span and is broken when the bearer is physically wounded.

rites.name: Veornanium
rites.text: A learned craft that gathers all the hostility aimed at a band of companions and shifts it onto one chosen member. It may only be invoked again once an hour has passed.

rites.name: Cilosia
rites.text: A form of swift bodily technique that belongs to the group of physical arts. It is practiced as one of the recognized ways of moving and acting quickly.

rites.name: Serialaunum
rites.text: A single-target sorcery that strikes one foe with liquid force. It is the lowest rung of its watery line and is opposed by flame.

rites.name: Coreolisium
rites.text: A combined technique that unleashes a volley of fiery strikes against foes. It proves most devastating against those vulnerable to heat, while it falls flat on creatures that feed on flame.

rites.name: Seoraustor
rites.text: A per-discipline resource that each fighter holds in an amount matching their current rank. Every technique costs part of this tally to be readied, which caps how many techniques can be prepared at once.

rites.name: Tirnia
rites.text: A small hitch in the workings of a traveling party, where a fighter who ducks away from a surprise strike ends up facing the foe again. It changes how they look but leaves their standing in the line untouched.

rites.name: Maunus
rites.text: A bound summoner's spirit-companion unleashes sworn powers in two command families, each followed by a cooling delay. Certain giant guardians act without any command at all, while lesser elemental spirits choose their own actions.

rites.name: Corentialum
rites.text: A mournful sung lament voiced by displaced wanderers who have settled in a crowded city after fleeing their homeland. It carries their longing for the rains of the lands they left behind.

rites.name: Tontesor
rites.text: A flowing power that renews the reserve a practitioner spends when calling upon their skills. It returns the energy needed to keep using those abilities.

rites.name: Nentoses
rites.text: Eight sung chants, each tied to one of the elemental forces, that only trained minstrels may perform. They shield the singer and allies against those forces and can be layered on top of other protective workings for added defense.

rites.name: Cianes
rites.text: A ranked dimming craft that a seasoned caster can learn by spending earned merit tokens. It is an improved form of a basic clouding art, sapping an opponent's aim and sight.

rites.name: Valasirum
rites.text: A swift technique that snaps the wielder back to a marked point of safety. It lets a caster escape danger in an instant by returning to a set anchor.

rites.name: Nones
rites.text: A discipline of the land calling, practiced by those who draw growing things from the soil. It belongs to the family of earth-bound crafts.

rites.name: Coriarnum
rites.text: A dark craft that siphons the inner essence of a foe into its caster. It is an improved form of a simpler siphoning rite, and its yield grows with the caster's skill. Empty-hearted creatures give nothing to it.

rites.name: Reontiasor
rites.text: A specialized fighting discipline that channels raw force and stored inner energy into devastating blows. Practitioners blend the techniques of several martial schools, and their passive training sharpens strikes that crack guard and reduce the cost of powerful moves.

rites.name: Reosanum
rites.text: A reflex craft that a traveling performer learns through practice, stirring a chance of inner resolve each time harm strikes. Spending earned growth lets the performer awaken this instinct, which rises whenever wounds are taken.

rites.name: Teliarnus
rites.text: A practiced technique that weakens a foe's arcane potency so their spells hit feebly. It can be applied again and again to the same target, though some guarded foes resist it.

rites.name: Coreliantus
rites.text: A restorative surge drawn from the living ground that clears every affliction from its user and nearby companions. It is a supportive technique passed among gifted healers in a wandering troupe.

rites.name: Rantum
rites.text: Companions chain their strikes against one foe in a precise order to trigger extra bonus effects. Once the chain is set, one of them releases it and the stacked moves fire on their own.

rites.name: Coraularium
rites.text: A beneficial state that sharpens a bearer's aim so that their strikes land more often. It can build up in layers on one target, and a rival condition works against it.

rites.name: Ciarnanum
rites.text: A dark craft that a warrior-mage may learn at a certain level of skill. Casting it siphons bodily might from a foe into the caster, and both shifts slowly fade away over time.

rites.name: Veonium
rites.text: A restorative ritual craft that a healer may master at a certain stage of training. Those gathered nearby are granted a lift to their inner resolve, and a sister practice grants the same strength to a different kind of caster.

rites.name: Sintasia
rites.text: A learned ritual rite that lets a practitioner wield a further set of destructive incantations while under a shadowed working. Taking hold of it replaces the earlier shadowed state and lasts for a long while.

rites.name: Carum
rites.text: A learned skill that lets a speaker of the orator craft address beasts and creatures while practicing another trade. Some orators and certain beast-kin are born already able to use it.

rites.name: Lelires
rites.text: A dimming of the mind that slips a bearer's memories out of reach, with its exact effects varying by the realm it strikes. It bears a loose kinship to a related clouding of wits.

rites.name: Menillus
rites.text: A practitioner's trained skill that heightens the strength of borrowed spells for a brief span. It can be invoked again only after a long rest.

rites.name: Cenor
rites.text: A third-rank radiant incantation that scorches the restless dead harder than lesser versions. It can also weaken an undead creature's hardness, and a stored sting of recent injury can swell its force.

rites.name: Seraulum
rites.text: A learned discipline of combat maneuvers that lets distant fighters strip armor and weaken an enemy's gear without closing in. It is prized as a support craft for archers and casters.

rites.name: Orantiles
rites.text: A bonded beast-call that a lancer may invoke once every twenty minutes, summoning a winged drake to join the fight alongside its master. Once the lancer's signature rite, it was later replaced by a surge of spirit.

rites.name: Vinanum
rites.text: A quiet inner talent that gives a wielder sway over others' hearts. It shapes how well tamed companions obey, how far a performer's songs strike home, and how strongly a healer's dances mend wounds. A dark warrior can siphon it from a foe.

rites.name: Tiseontia
rites.text: Two fighters leap together at a single foe and unleash a rapid volley of blows from a cannon-arm and bare fists. The strike jolts the target's guard, lengthening how long it stays off balance.

rites.name: Teliales
rites.text: A tiered surge of potency that a wielder gains after striking with an ancient arm of great power. Stronger surges arise when more reserved energy is spent on the blow, and a higher surge replaces a weaker one.

rites.name: Valiarnirus
rites.text: A chanted melody that a singer raises over allies, hardening their guard with each verse sung. Repeated verses build the protection higher, though the chant drains a little of the singer's inner reserve.

rites.name: Coralles Tiastor
rites.text: A summoner's trained bond that lets their spirit companions grant a steady, growing blessing to nearby allies, though the companions themselves must accept weaker strength in return.

rites.name: Amorales
rites.text: A caster's next restorative or protective incantation spreads outward to reach allies nearby. It works only while a certain radiant discipline is active, and lasts until one compatible charm is used or a minute passes.

rites.name: Calium
rites.text: A ruthless strike technique once used in battle by fighters of the old wardens. It was later abandoned and no longer taught in the training halls.

rites.name: Coreollanum
rites.text: A paired strike technique unlocked by a small glowing stone. It replaces an ordinary blow with one that lands twice on the same foe. Stronger versions of the stone later swap it for a quadruple strike.

rites.name: Coralus
rites.text: A companion throws their body in front of an ally to take a blow, leaving the protector briefly unable to move while the shielded one stays free to shift about. Each bonded fighter learns this bond at a different time.

rites.name: Tostirnum
rites.text: A recurring trick of spite that a wandering performer tends to use within troupe shows outside the main tales. Its wielder spins a ring of mocking gestures that unsettles nearby foes.

rites.name: Sirnaullor
rites.text: A flame-bound rite that a caller performs in contests of arms, drawing a burning spirit into the body. It links with several other workings of the caller and forms the center of their practice.

rites.name: Nonus
rites.text: Two companions combine their weapons in a shared strike. One hurls a blade skyward, the other empowers it, and together they unleash magical blasts that empower their foe's combat potential.

rites.name: Maules
rites.text: A ward-law that shields one chosen bearer from every blade, spell, and malady, yet grants no added strength. It is bestowed by a sovereign and lifted later by a judge's counter-decree.

rites.name: Serosanum
rites.text: A harmful earth-charm that weakens the striking force of every foe standing within the reach of a caster's bound stone spirit. Students must first master a lesser sibling charm and then seek a hidden well of earth-lore to learn it.

rites.name: Sausilia
rites.text: A binding state that locks a traveler or company into a duel with one chosen foe or pack. Outside aid is shut out, attacks on other creatures fail, and summoned companions are sent away until the struggle ends.

rites.name: Teostinia
rites.text: A bewildered bearer tries to use a tool, but the tool finds no mark to strike because the daze wears off first. Only a few charms still work without needing a target.

rites.name: Ameornianum
rites.text: A harmful earthen force that weighs down all foes standing within reach of a caster's bound stone totem. It is learned by a seeker who has first mastered a related gravity craft.

rites.name: Naurolor
rites.text: A debilitating condition that lowers a bearer's guard, and it can be layered many times over. Its opposing blessing restores the lost protection, though the afflicted figure looks no different.

rites.name: Valiania
rites.text: A wasting affliction caught from prolonged exposure to glowing mineral radiation. It causes deep exhaustion and a luminous skin, and it can strike the living and the dead alike. Those who recover become tougher and heal faster than before.

rites.name: Tiastornia
rites.text: A keeper of earth-currents calls a steadying flow that lifts the mind's guard of every companion standing within reach of a bound stone-spirit. The art is only taught at a sunken well on a lonely isle, to those who have first mastered a lesser current.

rites.name: Reolontium
rites.text: A set of seven mournful chants that slowly wear down a single foe, nearly impossible to shake off except by a cleansing rite. They are weak in force, yet a carved wind pipe can lengthen their hold.

rites.name: Telorus
rites.text: A stored count of performance charges that a dancer gathers through skilled steps. The charges can be spent on bursts of showy techniques, though they grant no benefit while they are simply held.

rites.name: Seonirnor
rites.text: A borrowed craft that lets a rogue draw a share of a companion's hostile attention onto themselves. It works only among those travelling in the same band and fails across larger gatherings.

rites.name: Lesus Orauria
rites.text: A dazed fighter's incantation is turned against allies, redirected toward the foes instead. Certain sorceries that normally refuse hostile targets can be coaxed into striking the enemy anyway.

rites.name: Vanollia
rites.text: Companions strike a pose as a fight begins and again when victory is won. The custom is shared by every member of the group, including temporary allies.

rites.name: Mornium
rites.text: A paired whirling strike shared by two fighters who leap together and hurl a spinning blade at a foe. It batters a single target and lengthens how long that target remains reeling.

rites.name: Mialum
rites.text: A flaw in a crafting ledger lets a bearer corrupt the record of an empty pouch slot, swapping it with a captured beast's hidden technique. The corruption can multiply a stored stock into hundreds of portions.

rites.name: Ceres
rites.text: A dark warrior readies a store of inner power to pour into a single blow. When the strike lands, the stored power turns into added force, and it fades if no blow connects in time.

rites.name: Seontia
rites.text: A restorative art that lifts a hex from a chosen person, though it does not mend the strength the hex has drained. It rarely undoes the deadly mark of a fell beast, yet it can sweep the hex away from a whole group when paired with certain rites.

rites.name: Liasania
rites.text: A stronger form of a basic healing craft, drawn from the first mending art. It restores the wounds of those who channel it through the living weave.

rites.name: Nilus
rites.text: A fourth-level flame incantation that strikes a single foe with searing heat. A summoner's ember-bound ally can also unleash a version of it as a bound pact strike.

rites.name: Corentanum
rites.text: A catalog of arcane workings sorted into many disciplines, from restorative and shielding arts to hostile and hidden crafts. One special working belongs to no discipline, asks nothing of its caster, and drains no resource to perform.

rites.name: Orisia
rites.text: A discipline of striking with heavy blunt and edged tools that drains an opponent's strength and resolve. Practitioners follow a sign of the stars and learn an expanding list of techniques through accumulated training points.

rites.name: Mallor
rites.text: A bladed wind-technique that a fighter can call upon while in the air, striking lightly without costing any energy. It transforms their ordinary sorcery into a sharper gust, and related techniques answer the flames, frost, and sparks of other fighters.

rites.name: Vernes
rites.text: A top-tier restorative art that healers master at an advanced stage of training. It can also be copied from a scroll bought through a merchant exchange.

rites.name: Corollium
rites.text: A minstrel's rite that lets a performer weave one additional tune into the chorus shared by companions for a short span. It can be invoked only once every hour.

rites.name: Larnaunium
rites.text: A combat technique where pairing two skills in one fighter may spark a stronger technique. The chance rises each time both skills are used, and a fighter learns it only once.

rites.name: Niallanum Corialium
rites.text: A channeled surge that lifts the burden of spirit-cost from every ally in the field. Once set, the effect holds until a companion falls or the clash ends, and no ward can strip it away.

rites.name: Saurnolus
rites.text: A second-rank healing rite that a practitioner of the mending craft may learn once they reach a set maturity. It can be bought from market sellers or bought through a trading hall, and it is the final mending of its tier that a borrowed-role apprentice can wield.

rites.name: Sosintor
rites.text: A ward-craft that a caster sets alight beside a hovering carved shell, lending sharper reasoning to every ally who stays within its glow. The craft must first be drawn from a frozen wellspring deep in the northern ice.

rites.name: Amaustum
rites.text: A closing crescendo of song that accompanies the ultimate foe of a grand saga. It is often called simply the last clash, and its later movements shift to match each stage of the climactic struggle.

rites.name: Seliranum
rites.text: A timed combat craft where bearers act once a glowing gauge fills, choosing from commands, bonded crystal powers, or summoned spirits. Desperate blows strike with overwhelming force when a fighter teeters near collapse.

rites.name: Tarnores
rites.text: A real-time combat craft where a chosen fighter roams freely across the field as foes appear, and orders are issued by menu or by pre-set conditions that fire when a charge meter fills.

rites.name: Seonternia
rites.text: Sealed sparks of power held by the chosen warriors of a rising realm. They rest unseen within the warriors and surface at a pivotal turning point in the chronicle.

rites.name: Meles Raustia
rites.text: A trained path of the hunt that teaches a wanderer to track and bring down beasts. It grants a natural knack for taking creatures unharmed, and it echoes an older, simpler calling of the field.

rites.name: Restium
rites.text: A third-rank restorative incantation that a healer-scholar can master upon reaching a certain level. Copies can be bought in market towns, and a summoned companion may also cast it.

rites.name: Orolum Colleorus
rites.text: A soaring technique that wipes the cooldowns of all leaping strikes, then lets the leaps be used again within a short window. It can be invoked only once every hour.

rites.name: Orellus
rites.text: A combined technique that a skilled tinkerer can unleash as a special burst. It strikes every foe at once with a heavy blow, and a well-prepared wielder can push its force past any normal limit.

rites.name: Taunia
rites.text: A recurring power that flows like liquid around its wielder. It first appeared in a long-running fantasy saga and is later tied to a single sorceress in side stories.

rites.name: Sornanum Seriastia
rites.text: A second-tier sky-fall craft drawn from a glowing crystal stone, it hurls four plain strikes at scattered foes and cannot be turned back. It can also be unleashed by a dust vial.

rites.name: Telernia
rites.text: A battle technique that raises the strength tier of a foe mid-clash. Its opposing counterpart lowers that tier instead. Certain mighty adversaries resist any shift in their standing.

rites.name: Mirneorum
rites.text: A combined technique that unleashes a volley of six frosty strikes on scattered foes, or concentrates the chill into one target for heavier harm. It is brewed from a frost-touched salvage piece gathered from chilled creatures.

rites.name: Vallianor
rites.text: A learned movement technique that lets a fighter spring one extra step higher than usual. Once mastered through practice, it can be taught and used by others among the wider fighting ranks.

rites.name: Marnianum
rites.text: A cloaking state that lets a bearer strike past every defense, though it fades once the bearer acts beyond simply moving or takes a blow. Foes keep sensing the cloaked one and can still strike at them.

rites.name: Tarnaunor
rites.text: A harmful sigil-craft that dulls the aim of every foe standing within the caster's surrounding aura. It must be mastered before its paired counterpart can be learned, and a trader in a frontier town sells it for a great sum.

rites.name: Vaunus
rites.text: A combined craft that fuses a frost-breath charm with a gale-song, striking several enemies at once with cold and wind. It is a refined version of an older, simpler frost-storm technique.

rites.name: Sasiarnium
rites.text: A timed technique that a warrior draws upon to briefly bind a foe in a chain-like hold, letting allies link their strikes into a combined surge. It can only be called again after a waiting period of three minutes.

rites.name: Lonus Valirnestes
rites.text: A harmful craft that drains the striking strength of every foe standing within its reach around the caster. It is taught by a merchant in a western city, and sealed chests from trials sometimes hold it. Its paired sister craft must be mastered before it can be learned.

rites.name: Corinum
rites.text: A flaw in the old cartridge code lets a clever wanderer gather an endless stock of nearly any goods, using a hurled-weapon technique and a sly pilfering skill together. The fault was patched in one later copy and never appears in newer ones.

rites.name: Cenor Telanternia
rites.text: A bound craft that dulls a foe's movements, sapping their speed for a time. It requires a single cord-tool to invoke and can be learned from fallen foes of the marsh clans.

rites.name: Oriarus
rites.text: A tinctured craft lets a healer spread a single remedy across every companion at once with its full potency. It can be paired with a ready-stock method to deliver the same cure repeatedly.

rites.name: Corauranes
rites.text: A sudden doom that ends a foe's life at once, ignoring how much vitality they still hold. Some creatures wielding it are feared, and it often has the opposite effect on the restless dead.

rites.name: Neostum
rites.text: A bound craft that lets its wielder spend only half the inner essence normally required to channel a practiced technique. Trainees of the summoning path must first earn it through their own accumulated study.

rites.name: Vones Niria
rites.text: A minor enchanting craft that, when invoked, strengthens the reasoning of every companion standing within the caster's aura. Its wider counterpart cannot be understood until this lesser form is mastered.

rites.name: Valania
rites.text: A minor frost-casting technique that deals a trace of cold harm while weakening a foe's defense against flame. It forms one link in a cyclical chain of elemental weakenings.

rites.name: Niares
